'''Litwick Mansion''' (Japanese: '''ヒトモシ屋敷''' ''{{tt|Hitomoshi|Litwick}} Mansion'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive building located along {{rt|4|Unova}} in [[Unova]]. It appeared in ''[[BW026|Scare at the Litwick Mansion!]]''.

Litwick Mansion was discovered by {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} while trying to get out of the rain. Unbeknownst to them, the mansion had been discovered by the [[Team Rocket trio]] first, and they planned to turn it into the base for [[Team Rocket]]'s Unova branch. However, the mansion was the home of four {{p|Litwick}} and a {{p|Lampent}}, who proceeded to try to scare Ash and his friends and drain Team Rocket's life force. The Litwick began to use {{m|Psychic}} to bring everyone closer to each other, where they lured them down to the mansion basement. Along the way, the Litwick abducted {{TP|Iris|Axew}}, {{TP|James|Yamask}}, {{AP|Pikachu}}, and {{MTR}}.

After the group confronted the Litwick and their leader Lampent, the {{type|Ghost}} Pokémon opened a vortex to the [[Ghost World]]. To trap everyone in the Ghost World they began using {{m|Shadow Ball}} and {{m|Inferno}}. However, everyone began to fight back with teamwork using Pikachu, {{AP|Oshawott}}, {{TP|Cilan|Dwebble}}, {{TP|Jessie|Woobat}}, and Yamask to save themselves and send the Litwick and Lampent back to the Ghost World. After defeating the Pokémon, they rushed outside to see that the mansion was actually in ruins, with Litick's earlier trickery making it appear in a decent state. Team Rocket soon fled, and as it began to rain again, Ash and his friends sought shelter in a tree hollow instead.
